答案:
[題號] Q1 🔴
📌 參考答案
B. 藻類、真菌
B. Algae, Fungi
📌 詳細解釋
植物P具備葉綠素，但不具備根、葉及種子，這是藻類的特徵。
Plant P has chlorophyll but lacks roots, leaves and seeds, which are the characteristics of algae.
植物Q沒有葉綠素，且不具備根、葉及種子，這符合真菌的特徵。
Plant Q does not contain chlorophyll, and has no roots, leaves and seeds, which matches the characteristics of fungi.
蕨類及蘚類植物均具有葉，因此選項A、C及D不正確。
Ferns and mosses possess leaves, so options A, C and D are incorrect.
📌 考試提醒
在傳統分類中，有否葉綠素以及根、莖、葉的分化是區分植物類別的關鍵。
In traditional classification, the presence of chlorophyll and the differentiation of roots, stems, and leaves are key to distinguishing plant groups.
常見錯誤：考生常忘記真菌界不含葉綠素，無法進行光合作用。
Common trap：Candidates often forget that fungi do not contain chlorophyll and cannot carry out photosynthesis.

[題號] Q2 🔴
📌 參考答案
C. 有花或無花
C. Presence or absence of flowers
📌 詳細解釋
植物R和S均具有根、葉及種子，說明它們皆屬於種子植物。
Both plants R and S possess roots, leaves and seeds, indicating they are seed plants.
種子植物可細分為不開花的裸子植物（如具有毬果）及有花的被子植物。
Seed plants can be subdivided into non-flowering gymnosperms (e.g. having cones) and flowering angiosperms.
因此，檢查它們是否有花能有效分辨其所屬類別。
Therefore, checking for the presence of flowers effectively distinguishes their taxonomic groups.
📌 考試提醒
被子植物與裸子植物的主要分別在於花及果實的有無。
The major difference between angiosperms and gymnosperms is the presence or absence of flowers and fruits.
常見錯誤：誤以為裸子植物以孢子繁殖，或不清楚裸子植物亦有種子。
Common trap：Mistakenly believing that gymnosperms reproduce by spores, or not knowing that gymnosperms also have seeds.

[題號] Q3 🔴
📌 參考答案
C. 在低倍顯微鏡下觀察葉的表皮
C. Observation of leaf epidermis under a low-power microscope
📌 詳細解釋
氣孔分佈在葉片的表皮上，故必須觀察表皮平面而非葉的橫切面。
Stomata are present on the lower epidermis, so the epidermal surface must be observed rather than the transverse section.
低倍顯微鏡能覆蓋較大面積的樣本，提供較廣闊的視野。
A low-power microscope covers a larger area of the specimen, providing a wider field of view.
這有助觀察更多氣孔，從而得出較準確的氣孔密度估算。
This allows more stomata to be observed, giving a more accurate estimation of stomatal density.
📌 考試提醒
估算種群或特定結構的密度時，較大的取樣面積能有效減低隨機誤差。
When estimating the density of a population or specific structure, a larger sampling area effectively reduces random errors.
常見錯誤：誤以為高倍顯微鏡放大倍數越高，估算就越準確，忽略了視野變窄的問題。
Common trap：Mistakenly believing that higher magnification yields a more accurate estimation, ignoring the narrowed field of view.

[題號] Q4 🔴
📌 參考答案
D. 使某些細胞構造更明顯
D. To make certain cell structures more distinct
📌 詳細解釋
大多數細胞和組織成分是無色透明的，難以在顯微鏡下觀察。
Most cell and tissue components are colourless and transparent, making them difficult to observe under a microscope.
加入碘液作為染色劑能增加組織的對比度。
Adding iodine solution as a stain increases the contrast of the tissue.
這使得細胞結構更容易被識別和觀察。
This makes the structures more easily recognized and observed.
📌 考試提醒
碘液在生物學實驗中有雙重用途：測試澱粉及作為觀察細胞結構的染色劑。
Iodine solution has dual purposes in biological experiments: testing for starch and acting as a stain to observe cell structures.
常見錯誤：死記碘液僅用於澱粉測試，忽略了其作為細胞染色劑的功能。
Common trap：Memorizing iodine solely for starch testing while ignoring its function as a cell stain.

[題號] Q5 🔴
📌 參考答案
D. 只有(2)和(3)
D. (2) and (3) only
📌 詳細解釋
胃壁分泌的黏液能防止食物直接摩擦胃壁，提供物理性保護。
The mucus secreted by the stomach wall prevents food from rubbing against it, providing physical protection.
它同時能保護胃部內表面，免受胃液中的鹽酸及胃蛋白酶侵蝕。
It also protects the inner surface of the stomach against erosion by hydrochloric acid and pepsin.
殺死進入消化道的細菌是鹽酸的功能，並非黏液的作用。
Killing bacteria that enter the alimentary canal is the function of hydrochloric acid, not mucus.
📌 考試提醒
消化道的黏液層提供了物理及化學屏障，防止器官被消化液自我消化。
The mucus layer in the alimentary canal provides physical and chemical barriers to prevent organs from self-digestion by digestive juices.
常見錯誤：混淆胃酸與黏液的生理功能。
Common trap：Confusing the physiological functions of gastric acid and mucus.

[題號] Q6 🔴
📌 參考答案
B. 肝癌
B. Liver cancer
📌 詳細解釋
癡肥與多種慢性疾病息息相關，可導致糖尿病、高血壓及冠心病。
Obesity is closely related to various chronic diseases and can lead to diabetes, high blood pressure and coronary heart disease.
然而，肝癌的成因主要是病毒感染或毒素，與癡肥沒有直接關聯。
However, liver cancer is mainly caused by viral infections or toxins, and is not directly related to obesity.
📌 考試提醒
心血管疾病及二型糖尿病與不良飲食習慣及脂肪積聚有直接因果關係。
Cardiovascular diseases and type II diabetes have a direct causal relationship with poor dietary habits and fat accumulation.
常見錯誤：錯誤以為所有嚴重的內臟疾病均由肥胖直接引起。
Common trap：Mistakenly believing that all severe internal organ diseases are directly caused by obesity.

[題號] Q7 🔴
📌 參考答案
A. 蠶豆
A. Broad bean
📌 詳細解釋
碳水化合物、脂肪和蛋白質的能量值分別為 17.1 kJ/g、38.9 kJ/g 及 18.2 kJ/g。
The energy values of carbohydrates, fats and proteins are 17.1 kJ/g, 38.9 kJ/g and 18.2 kJ/g respectively.
100克蠶豆的總能量值為 (12×17.1) + (0.7×38.9) + (9×18.2) = 396.23 kJ，為四者中最高。
The total energy value of 100g broad beans is (12×17.1) + (0.7×38.9) + (9×18.2) = 396.23 kJ, which is the highest among the four.
雖然馬鈴薯碳水化合物較多，但蛋白質極少，總能量值不及蠶豆。
Although potatoes have more carbohydrates, their protein content is very low, making the total energy less than that of broad beans.
📌 考試提醒
比較食物的總能量時，必須綜合計算三大宏量營養素（碳水化合物、脂肪、蛋白質）的能量總和。
When comparing the total energy of foods, one must calculate the sum of the energy from all three macronutrients (carbohydrates, fats, proteins).
常見錯誤：只比較單一營養素（如碳水化合物）的數值大小，忽略了整體總和。
Common trap：Comparing only the value of a single nutrient (e.g. carbohydrates) and ignoring the overall sum.

[題號] Q8 🔴
📌 參考答案
C. 菠菜
C. Spinach
📌 詳細解釋
在暗淡光線下不能清楚視物是夜盲症的病徵，這與缺乏維生素A有關。
The inability to see clearly in dim light is a symptom of night blindness, which is related to a lack of vitamin A.
胡蘿蔔素能在肝臟中轉化為維生素A，而維生素A是合成視網膜上視紫的必需物質。
Carotene can be converted into vitamin A in the liver, and vitamin A is essential for the formation of visual purple for night vision.
菠菜含有最高分量的胡蘿蔔素，因此最能幫助改善此毛病。
Spinach contains the greatest amount of carotene, making it the most helpful for improving this disorder.
📌 考試提醒
視網膜上的視桿細胞負責暗視力，其感光色素（視紫）的合成需要維生素A。
Rod cells on the retina are responsible for dim-light vision, and the synthesis of their photosensitive pigment (visual purple) requires vitamin A.
常見錯誤：未能將胡蘿蔔素與維生素A的作用連結，或忘記視紫與夜視能力的關係。
Common trap：Failing to link the role of carotene with vitamin A, or forgetting the relationship between visual purple and night vision.

[題號] Q9 🔴
📌 參考答案
B. 餐後刷牙
B. Brushing the teeth after meals
📌 詳細解釋
採用較大刷頭或大力刷牙並不能防止蛀牙。
Using a toothbrush with a larger head and brushing the teeth harder do not prevent tooth decay.
不吃甜食是好方法，但進食其他含澱粉的食物依然會導致蛀牙。
Avoiding sugary food is a good method, but starchy food may also lead to tooth decay.
餐後刷牙能及時清除牙齒表面的食物殘渣及細菌，是防止蛀牙最有效的方法。
Brushing the teeth after meals promptly removes food debris and bacteria from the tooth surface, making it the best method.
📌 考試提醒
蛀牙是由細菌分解口腔內的碳水化合物產生酸性物質所引致的。
Tooth decay is caused by bacteria decomposing carbohydrates in the mouth to produce acidic substances.
常見錯誤：誤以為蛀牙純粹由糖分引起，忽略了澱粉質同樣會被分解成糖分供細菌利用。
Common trap：Mistakenly believing that tooth decay is solely caused by sugar, ignoring that starch is also broken down into sugars for bacterial use.

[題號] Q10 🔴
📌 參考答案
C. 只有(2)和(3)
C. (2) and (3) only
📌 詳細解釋
牙膏中的氟化物能減少蛀牙。
Fluoride compounds in toothpaste reduce tooth decay.
具打磨功效的微粒能以物理方式清除牙齒表面的垢膜（牙菌膜）。
Grinding particles can physically remove plaque from the surface of the teeth.
牙齒生長所需的鈣質必須從日常飲食中攝取，無法透過使用含鈣牙膏直接吸收。
Calcium needed for tooth growth must be taken from the diet and cannot be absorbed directly from brushing with a calcium-containing toothpaste.
📌 考試提醒
氟化物的防蛀機制是在牙齒表面發揮作用，而礦物質的吸收必須透過消化系統。
The anti-decay mechanism of fluoride works on the tooth surface, whereas the absorption of minerals must occur through the digestive system.
常見錯誤：考生常誤以為牙膏內的鈣質能直接滲入並鞏固牙齒結構。
Common trap：Candidates often mistakenly believe that calcium in toothpaste can directly penetrate and strengthen the tooth structure.

[題號] Q11 🔴
📌 參考答案
A. 熱帶雨林、沙漠、浸沒水中
A. Tropical rain forest, Desert, Submerged in water
📌 詳細解釋
植物R不具氣孔，氣體只能自由在葉片表面擴散，這是浸沒水中的特徵。
Plant R lacks stomata, so gases freely diffuse through the whole leaf surface, which indicates it is submerged in water.
植物Q具針狀葉，能減低蒸騰作用的速率以減少水分流失，適合生長在如沙漠的乾燥環境。
Plant Q has needle-like leaves which lower the rate of transpiration to minimize water loss, suitable for dry environments such as the desert.
植物P具闊大扁平葉片，有利進行光合作用及較高蒸騰作用，適合生長於水分供應充足的熱帶雨林。
Plant P has broad and flat leaves promoting photosynthesis and a greater transpiration rate, making it suitable for tropical rain forests where water supply is abundant.
📌 考試提醒
葉片形態與氣孔分佈是植物適應特定生境（水分及光照條件）的演化特徵。
Leaf morphology and stomatal distribution are evolutionary features for plants to adapt to specific habitats (water and light conditions).
常見錯誤：不明白為何水生植物不需氣孔，或未將針狀葉與減少水分流失建立關聯。
Common trap：Not understanding why aquatic plants do not need stomata, or failing to link needle-like leaves with minimizing water loss.

[題號] Q12 🔴
📌 參考答案
C. 只有(1)和(2)
C. (1) and (2) only
📌 詳細解釋
豬籠草的綠色葉片能進行光合作用，將無機物合成複雜有機物，屬於自養營養。
The green leaf of the pitcher plant can carry out photosynthesis to synthesize complex compounds from simple inorganic raw material, which is autotrophic nutrition.
它同時具有消化昆蟲的構造，從其他生物體獲取固體有機物，屬於動物式營養。
It also has insect-digesting structures to feed on solid organic material from other organisms, which is holozoic nutrition.
它並不依賴寄生方式吸取養分，所以不屬寄生營養。
It does not rely on parasitic means to absorb nutrients, so it is not parasitic nutrition.
📌 考試提醒
食蟲植物是少數同時表現出自養營養及動物式營養的生物。
Insectivorous plants are among the few organisms that exhibit both autotrophic and holozoic nutrition.
常見錯誤：誤將食蟲行為等同於寄生營養，忽略了寄生的嚴格定義。
Common trap：Mistaking insectivorous behaviour as equivalent to parasitic nutrition, ignoring the strict definition of parasitism.

[題號] Q13 🔴
📌 參考答案
D. 氮含量低的泥土
D. Soil with low nitrogen content
📌 詳細解釋
豬籠草消化昆蟲後，昆蟲會變成營養的一部分。
The structure digests insects which become part of the nutrition.
這個額外的營養來源彌補了泥土中含氮化合物的不足。
This extra source of nitrogenous compounds compensates for the lack of nitrogen in the soil.
這使植物能夠在氮含量低的泥土中生長。
This helps the plants to grow in soil with low nitrogen content.
📌 考試提醒
植物合成蛋白質必須依賴含氮化合物（如硝酸鹽）；食蟲演化是為了補充無機氮不足。
Plants must rely on nitrogenous compounds (like nitrates) to synthesize proteins; insectivorous evolution aims to supplement inorganic nitrogen deficiency.
常見錯誤：誤以為食蟲是為了獲取碳水化合物或能量以代替光合作用。
Common trap：Mistakenly believing that catching insects is for obtaining carbohydrates or energy to replace photosynthesis.

[題號] Q14 🔴
📌 參考答案
D. R至T
D. R to T
📌 詳細解釋
吸氣時，胸腔體積增加，導致肺內空氣壓力下降。
During inhalation, the volume of the thoracic cavity increases and thus the pressure in the cavity decreases.
當肺內氣壓低於大氣壓力時，外界空氣會被壓入肺部。
The greater atmospheric pressure forces air into the lungs to inflate them.
在曲線圖中，只有R至T段的肺內氣壓低於大氣壓（760 mm Hg）。
In the graph, only the segment from R to T shows lung air pressure below the atmospheric pressure.
📌 考試提醒
肺部通氣（吸氣與呼氣）的動力完全取決於肺內氣壓與大氣壓之間的相對壓力差。
The driving force for pulmonary ventilation (inhalation and exhalation) depends entirely on the relative pressure difference between lung air pressure and atmospheric pressure.
常見錯誤：混淆了氣壓變化的方向，誤以為氣壓上升的波段（P至Q）代表吸氣。
Common trap：Confusing the direction of pressure changes and mistakenly thinking that the rising pressure segment (P to Q) represents inhalation.

[題號] Q15 🔴
📌 參考答案
D. 放鬆、呈拱形
D. Relaxed, Dome-shaped
📌 詳細解釋
時間點Q代表肺內氣壓最大的時刻，此時處於呼氣階段。
At Q, the pressure is maximum, which happens during expiration.
呼氣時，肋間肌放鬆，使肋骨回覆原狀。
During expiration, the intercostal muscles relax so that the ribs fall back to their original position.
同時，橫膈膜肌肉放鬆，橫膈膜回復呈拱形。
The diaphragm muscles relax and the diaphragm returns to dome-shape.
📌 考試提醒
放鬆狀態的橫膈膜是呈拱形的；當它收縮時才會變平以增加胸腔垂直體積。
A relaxed diaphragm is dome-shaped; it only flattens upon contraction to increase the vertical volume of the thoracic cavity.
常見錯誤：記錯肌肉收縮與放鬆對應的形狀變化。
Common trap：Memorizing incorrectly the corresponding shape changes during muscle contraction and relaxation.

[題號] Q16 🔴
📌 參考答案
C. 減少、增加
C. Decreased, Increased
📌 詳細解釋
劇烈運動時，呼吸變得更頻密，完成一次呼吸的時間縮短，故P與T的距離減少。
During exercise, the person breathes more frequently, thus the time between P and T shortens.
同時，呼吸深度增加，使呼氣時肺內氣壓與大氣壓的差異更大，故H與Q的距離增加。
The person also breathes harder and more forcefully, making the difference between the air pressure inside the lung and atmospheric pressure greater, so the distance between H and Q is increased.
📌 考試提醒
圖表中的波長反映呼吸頻率，而振幅反映呼吸深度。
In the graph, the wavelength reflects breathing frequency, and the amplitude reflects breathing depth.
常見錯誤：未能將圖表的幾何特徵準確對應至呼吸的生理參數。
Common trap：Failing to accurately map the geometric features of the graph to physiological parameters of breathing.

[題號] Q17 🔴
📌 參考答案
D. 酵母在高葡萄糖濃度下不能進行缺氧呼吸。
D. The yeast cannot carry out anaerobic respiration at a high glucose concentration.
📌 詳細解釋
實驗結果指出，高葡萄糖濃度下沒有酒精產生。
The results indicate that at high glucose concentration no alcohol is formed.
由於酒精是缺氧呼吸的產物，沒有酒精即代表缺氧呼吸未能進行。
As the production of alcohol is the direct result of anaerobic respiration, we can deduce that anaerobic respiration cannot carry out.
由於實驗沒有測試酵母是否存活，我們不能直接推論酵母已因脫水死亡。
Since no test on whether the yeast are alive is carried out, we cannot deduce that the yeast died from dehydration.
📌 考試提醒
科學探究中，結論必須嚴格建基於實驗數據，切勿將理論推測當作實驗的直接觀察。
In scientific inquiry, conclusions must be strictly based on experimental data; do not treat theoretical speculations as direct experimental observations.
常見錯誤：過度推論，把滲透作用導致死亡的背景知識當作此實驗的直接結論。
Common trap：Over-inferring by treating the background knowledge of osmotic death as the direct conclusion of this experiment.

[題號] Q18 🔴
📌 參考答案
B. 只有(3)和(4)
B. (3) and (4) only
📌 詳細解釋
將葡萄糖溶液煮沸能清除溶解在溶液中的氧氣。
Boiling the glucose solution evacuates oxygen dissolving in the glucose solution.
加入石蠟油能防止錐形瓶內的氧氣進入溶液中。
Adding paraffin oil prevents oxygen in air in the conical flask from going into the solution.
這兩種方法都是確保缺氧條件必需採取的措施。
These 2 measures are essential to ensure an anaerobic condition.
📌 考試提醒
液體表面的油層及事前煮沸，是探究缺氧呼吸中建立缺氧條件的標準技巧。
An oil layer on the liquid surface and prior boiling are standard techniques for establishing anaerobic conditions in experiments on anaerobic respiration.
常見錯誤：誤以為單純塞緊瓶口就能創造完全缺氧的環境。
Common trap：Mistakenly believing that merely sealing the flask tightly creates a completely anaerobic environment.

[題號] Q19 🔴
📌 參考答案
A. 只有(1)
A. (1) only
📌 詳細解釋
缺氧呼吸產生的氣體是二氧化碳，它能將石灰水轉為乳白色，因此石灰水可用來測試該氣體。
The gas produced is carbon dioxide which turns lime water milky, so lime water can be used to test the gas.
氫氧化鈉溶液吸收二氧化碳後形成無色水溶性鹽，沒有外觀變化，不適合用作測試。
Sodium hydroxide absorbs carbon dioxide to form aqueous colourless salts and thus cannot serve as a test for carbon dioxide.
碳酸氫鈉溶液與二氧化碳亦沒有明顯的化學反應。
Sodium hydrogencarbonate solution does not react too much with carbon dioxide.
📌 考試提醒
定性測試試劑必須能與目標物質產生清晰可見的變化。
A qualitative test reagent must produce a clear, visible change with the target substance.

抗生素是殺菌的化學物質，不一定屬於蛋白質，並且是毒死細菌而非吞沒細菌。
Antibiotics are bactericidal chemicals, not necessarily proteins, and they are toxic to bacteria rather than engulfing them.
抗生素本身不是抗原，不能（也不會）和專特的抗體結合。
Antigens, not antibiotics, bind to specific antibodies.

抗生素的藥理機制是破壞細菌特定的代謝途徑或結構（如細胞壁），故對人體細胞及病毒無效。
The pharmacological mechanism of antibiotics is disrupting specific bacterial metabolic pathways or structures (like cell walls), so they are ineffective against human cells and viruses.
常見錯誤：將抗生素的殺菌機制與白血球的吞噬作用或抗體-抗原反應混淆。
Common trap：Confusing the bactericidal mechanism of antibiotics with the phagocytosis of white blood cells or antibody-antigen reactions.

In ecological interactions, when the coexistence of two species suppresses and lowers the environmental carrying capacity for both, it represents an interspecific competition relationship.

種群數目增長的曲線最終保持水平，代表該種群數目的大小達致動態平衡，沒有改變。
The population growth curves level off, meaning that the population sizes do not change any more.
這意味著新個體出生的數量剛好抵消死亡的數量。
This implies that the number of newly born individuals perfectly offsets the number of deaths.
即當每種微生物的繁殖速率（出生率）相等於其死亡率時，曲線就會保持水平。
It does not change when the rate of reproduction is equal to the rate of death of each species.
若養分完全耗盡，死亡率會急增並大於繁殖速率，導致種群崩潰下降（排除A）。
If nutrients are completely exhausted, the death rate will spike and exceed the reproduction rate, causing the population to crash (excluding A).

S型種群增長曲線的平穩期並不代表生物停止繁殖，而是整體的出生與死亡達到動態平衡。
The stationary phase of an S-shaped population growth curve does not mean organisms stop reproducing, but rather that overall births and deaths have reached a dynamic equilibrium.
常見錯誤：誤以為曲線變平是因為所有細菌都停止了分裂和死亡活動。
Common trap：Mistakenly believing that the curve flattens because all bacteria have stopped dividing and dying.

[題號] Q58 🔴

污水排放口排入大量有機廢物，導致負責分解污穢物的細菌數目急劇增加。
The discharge of a large amount of organic wastes leads to a sharp increase in the bacterial population that decomposes the sewage.
細菌數目的增加加速了有機物的分解，過程中釋放出大量氨。
The increased bacterial population accelerates the decomposition of organic matter, releasing a large amount of ammonia in the process.
由於這些微生物進行需氧呼吸會大量消耗水中的氧氣，因此溶氧水平會顯著減少。
Because these micro-organisms consume a massive amount of oxygen during aerobic respiration, the level of dissolved oxygen decreases significantly.
📌 考試提醒
水質受有機物污染時，生化需氧量（BOD）會上升，導致水中的溶氧量（DO）隨之下降。
When water is polluted by organic matter, Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD) rises, causing Dissolved Oxygen (DO) to fall accordingly.
常見錯誤：忽視了分解作用是由需氧細菌主導，從而未能推斷出氧氣會被大量消耗。

[題號] Q59 🔴

當污水中的有機污穢物在P點被細菌分解後，會釋出無機離子，形成大量硝酸鹽。
After sewage is decomposed by bacteria at P, inorganic ions are released and large amounts of nitrates are formed.
這些硝酸鹽隨水流帶至Q點，作為藻類生長所需的豐富肥料。
These nitrates flow to Q and serve as abundant fertilizers for the algae.
養分的飆升引發了藻華，因此由P到Q，藻類的種群數目大幅增加。
The surge in nutrients triggers an algal bloom, therefore the population of algae increases from P to Q.

藻類是水生生態系統的生產者，依賴吸收無機鹽（如硝酸鹽及磷酸鹽）生長，而非直接攝取有機物。
Algae are producers in aquatic ecosystems and rely on absorbing inorganic salts (like nitrates and phosphates) for growth, rather than directly taking in organic matter.
常見錯誤：誤以為藻類會直接利用污水中的固體有機物作為營養來源。

[題號] Q60 🔴
📌 參考答案
B. 將空氣泵入污水
B. Pumping air into the sewage
📌 詳細解釋
分解污水內有機物的主要過程，依賴微生物進行的需氧呼吸作用。
The main process of decomposing organic substances in sewage relies on the aerobic respiration carried out by micro-organisms.
將空氣泵入污水能增加氧氣的供應，提升水中的溶氧量。
Pumping air into the sewage increases the oxygen supply and elevates the dissolved oxygen level in the water.
這極大有利於污水中的需氧細菌更迅速及有效率地分解有機物。
This greatly favours the sewage bacteria to decompose the organic substances more rapidly and efficiently.
📌 考試提醒
在二級污水處理中，曝氣池（Aeration tank）的作用正是持續供氧，以優化細菌的生物分解效率。
In secondary sewage treatment, the exact role of the aeration tank is to continuously supply oxygen to optimize the biological decomposition efficiency of bacteria.
常見錯誤：未搞清污水處理中一級處理（沉澱過濾的物理法）與二級處理（依賴細菌的生物法）的核心差異。
Common trap：Failing to clarify the core differences between primary treatment (physical methods of sedimentation and filtration) and secondary treatment (biological methods relying on bacteria) in sewage treatment.
